text: So, I understand you're interested in restaurant work?
translation: 那么，我了解到你对餐饮业的工作感兴趣？

text: Yes.
translation: 是的。

text: I've got a bit of experience and I can provide references.
translation: 我有一点经验，而且我可以提供推荐人。

text: That's good.
translation: 那很好。

text: I can check all that later.
translation: 我稍后可以核实所有这些。

text: Now, Milo's Restaurants have some vacancies at the moment.
translation: 现在，Milo's Restaurants 目前有一些职位空缺。

text: They're a really good company to work for.
translation: 他们是一家非常值得为之工作的好公司。

text: Lots of benefits.
translation: 很多福利。

text: Oh right.
translation: 哦，好的。

text: Yes.
translation: 是的。

text: They've got a very good reputation for looking after staff.
translation: 他们在照顾员工方面声誉很好。

text: For example, all employees get training – even temporary staff.
translation: 例如，所有员工都会接受培训——甚至是临时员工。

text: Oh really?
translation: 哦，真的吗？

text: That's quite unusual, isn't it?
translation: 那很不寻常，不是吗？

text: Certainly is.
translation: 确实是。

text: And do staff get free uniforms too?
translation: 那员工也能免费获得制服吗？

text: Um… you just need to wear a white T-shirt and black trousers, it says here.
translation: 嗯……这里说，你只需要穿一件白色T恤和黑色长裤。

text: So I guess not… But another benefit of working for a big company like this is that you can get a discount at any of their restaurants.
translation: 所以我想不是……但在这样的大公司工作的另一个好处是，你可以在他们的任何一家餐厅享受折扣。

text: Even at weekends?
translation: 甚至在周末也是？

text: No, but you'll be working then anyway.
translation: 不是，但反正你那时候也要上班。

text: Oh yes.
translation: 哦，是的。

text: I suppose so.
translation: 我想是这样。

text: Most of their restaurants are in the city centre, aren't they?
translation: 他们大多数餐厅都在市中心，对吧？

text: So, easy to get to by bus?
translation: 那么，坐公交车去方便吗？

text: Yes.
translation: 是的。

text: That's right.
translation: 没错。

text: But if you have to do a late shift and finish work after midnight, the company will pay for you to get a taxi home.
translation: 但如果你要上晚班，午夜之后才下班，公司会为你付打车回家的费用。

text: I probably won't need one.
translation: 我大概不需要。

text: I think I'd use my bike.
translation: 我想我会骑自行车。

text: OK.
translation: 好的。

text: Now, they do have some quite specific requirements for the kind of person they're looking for.
translation: 现在，他们确实对他们要找的那种人有一些相当具体的要求。

text: Milo's is a young, dynamic company and they're really keen on creating a strong team.
translation: Milo's 是一家年轻、有活力的公司，他们非常热衷于打造一支强大的团队。

text: It's really important that you can fit in and get on well with everyone.
translation: 你能融入其中并与每个人相处融洽，这非常重要。

text: Yeah.
translation: 是的。

text: I've got no problem with that.
translation: 我对此没有问题。

text: It sounds good, actually.
translation: 实际上，听起来不错。

text: The last place I worked for was quite demanding too.
translation: 我上一个工作的地方要求也很高。

text: We had to make sure we gave a really high level of service.
translation: 我们必须确保提供非常高水平的服务。
highlights: a really high level of service

text: That's good to hear because that will be equally important at Milo's.
translation: 很高兴听到这个，因为那在 Milo's 也同样重要。

text: I know they want people who have an eye for detail.
translation: 我知道他们想要对细节有敏锐眼光的人。

text: That's fine.
translation: 那没问题。

text: I'm very used to working in that kind of environment.
translation: 我很习惯在那种环境中工作。

text: Perfect.
translation: 完美。

text: So the only other thing that's required is good communication skills, so you'll need to have a certificate in English.
translation: 所以唯一还需要的另一样东西就是良好的沟通能力，因此你需要有一份英语证书。

text: Sure.
translation: 当然。

text: OK.
translation: 好的。

text: Let's have a look at the current job vacancies at Milo's.
translation: 我们来看看米洛公司目前的职位空缺吧。

text: The first one is in Wivenhoe Street.
translation: 第一个在威文霍街。

text: Sorry, where?
translation: 抱歉，在哪里？

text: Wivenhoe.
translation: 威文霍。

text: W-l-V-E-N-H-O-E.
translation: W-l-V-E-N-H-O-E。

text: It's quite central, just off Cork Street.
translation: 它位置相当中心，就在科克街旁边。

text: Oh right.
translation: 哦，好的。

text: They're looking for a breakfast supervisor.
translation: 他们在找一位早餐部主管。

text: That would be OK.
translation: 那应该可以。

text: So you're probably familiar with the kind of responsibilities involved.
translation: 所以你可能对涉及的那类职责比较熟悉。

text: Obviously checking that all the portions are correct, etc., and then things like checking all the procedures for cleaning the equipment are being followed.
translation: 显然要检查所有份量是否准确等等，然后还要检查清洁设备的所有流程是否得到遵守。

text: OK.
translation: 好的。

text: And what about the salary?
translation: 那薪水怎么样？

text: In my last job I was getting £9.50 per hour.
translation: 我上一份工作是每小时9.50英镑。

text: I was hoping to get a bit more than that.
translation: 我原本希望得到的比那多一点。

text: Well, to begin with, you'd be getting £9.75 but that goes up to £11.25 after three months.
translation: 嗯，首先，你一开始能拿到 9.75 英镑，但三个月后会涨到 11.25 英镑。

text: That's not too bad.
translation: 那还不算太糟。

text: And I suppose it's a very early start?
translation: 而且我想开始得很早吧？

text: Mmm.
translation: 嗯。

text: That's the only unattractive thing about this job.
translation: 这是这份工作唯一不吸引人的地方。

text: But then you have the afternoons and evenings free.
translation: 但那样的话，你下午和晚上就都有空了。

text: So the restaurant starts serving breakfast from 7 a.m.
translation: 所以餐厅从早上 7 点开始供应早餐。

text: And you'd have to be there at 5.30 to set everything up.
translation: 而且你得在 5 点半到那里把所有东西都准备好。

text: But you'd be finished at 12.30.
translation: 但你 12 点半就下班了。

text: Mmm.
translation: 嗯。

text: Well, as you say, there are advantages to that.
translation: 嗯，正如你所说，那有它的好处。

text: Now, you might also be interested in the job at the City Road branch.
translation: 现在，你可能也会对City Road分店的那份工作感兴趣。

text: That's for a junior chef, so again a position of responsibility.
translation: 那是初级厨师的职位，所以同样是一个需要承担责任的岗位。

text: I might prefer that, actually.
translation: 其实，我可能更倾向于那个。

text: Right, well obviously this role would involve supporting the sous chef and other senior staff.
translation: 好，显然这个职位需要协助副主厨和其他资深员工。

text: And you'd be responsible for making sure there's enough stock each week – and sorting out all the deliveries.
translation: 而且你要负责确保每周有足够的库存——并安排好所有送货事宜。

text: I've never done that before, but I imagine it's fairly straightforward, once you get the hang of it.
translation: 我以前从没做过那个，但我想一旦你掌握了窍门，它就相当简单。

text: Yes, and you'd be working alongside more experienced staff to begin with, so I'm sure it wouldn't be a problem.
translation: 是的，而且一开始你会和经验更丰富的员工一起工作，所以我肯定那不会是个问题。

text: The salary's slightly higher here.
translation: 这里的薪水稍微高一些。

text: It's an annual salary of £23,000.
translation: 年薪是23,000英镑。

text: Right.
translation: 对。

text: I know that if they like you, it's likely you'll be promoted quite quickly.
translation: 我知道如果他们喜欢你，你很可能会很快被提拔。

text: So that's worth thinking about.
translation: 所以这一点值得考虑。

text: Yes.
translation: 是的。

text: It does sound interesting.
translation: 听起来确实挺有意思的。

text: What are the hours like?
translation: 工作时间怎么样？

text: The usual, I think.
translation: 我想就是平常那样吧。

text: There's a lot of evening and weekend work, but they're closed on Mondays.
translation: 有很多晚上和周末的工作，但他们周一不营业。

text: But you do get one Sunday off every four weeks.
translation: 但你每四周确实能休一个周日。

text: So would you like me to send off your…
translation: 那么您希望我把您的……寄出去吗？
